_comment: The ONE table of e2e flows: the row metadata for scripts/e2e-report.py. 'expected' must say what the flow's yaml asserts (and, for click-token flows, what the install check expects); in real/play rows {product} and {voucher} are filled from the run's expect_product / expect_voucher (defaults in scripts/e2e-env.json). No hosts, slugs or URLs here: the report shows each row's tested link from the results. Android deny flows still route: consent gates attribution, not navigation. 'link_type_matrix': the flow also runs once per link type (scripts/e2e-env.json link_types) as <flow>__<type>, on that type's link; 'link_type_expected' is those rows' Expected ({type} and {source} filled in; an allow run also asserts the debug meta row, see scripts/e2e-env.py prepare-flow). 'link_type_only': a matrix flow with no plain row, only its <flow>__<type> rows (the re-engagement rows, which need a type's link). 'expect_from': "link_type_expect" fills {product} / {voucher} from link_type_expect instead of the run's expect (the reward flows' links carry the link types' customData). 'suite': simulated (scripts/*.yaml) or real (scripts/real/).
